build_FeatureExtractor: build a FeatureExtractor model with a ResNet50 encoder and FPN decoder for image feature extraction
create_DecoderBlock: create a DecoderBlock that upsamples and fuses skip connections with bilinear interpolation and padding
create_FPN: create a Feature Pyramid Network decoder that merges multi-scale encoder features into a single output
build_encoder_resnet: build a ResNet encoder with configurable downsampling layers using torchvision feature extraction
remove_conv_stride: remove the stride from a Conv2d layer and replace it with stride 1 while preserving weights
